name: table
title: Feature table
about: Shows the features themselves (level 3): one row per feature of the selected clusters, with its ids and every annotation column.

shows.columns: ID, cluster, type and every annotation column, level 1 and level 2 among them
shows.links: id columns open the entry of the id in its database
shows.own controls: search, sort, a value filter on every column, page size; these stay inside the table and do not reach the other views

reads.level1: only the passing features (when the scope is filtered); level 1 is also a column
reads.level2: only the passing features (when the scope is filtered); level 2 is also a column
reads.scope: filtered features, or every feature of the selected clusters

features.name: level3_ids
features.how: features found by an id in a level-3 column (the feature id or a linked id column)

features.name: level3_summary
features.how: the ids of a level-3 column in a cluster: the most frequent, the share of features that have one, or the list

target.feature_lookup: where does this id / gene fall

descriptor.level3_column + level3_mode: see the lookup card when loaded.
